text:
Mia Chen: Quick design riff — thinking about route granularity + focus trap when we collapse workspace groups in the left nav. If we collapse a group, should breadcrumb still show the inner route or the parent? Thinking about deep-linking consistency and keyboard navigation. @Samir @Noah :eyes:
Samir Patel: I lean toward keeping the full inner route in the URL (and breadcrumb) so permalinks always land on the exact leaf. Collapse is purely UI state. Keeps back/forward behavior predictable.
Noah Rivera: Agree on permalinks, but we need to consider focus management: if you deep-link to a collapsed child, the focus should move into the group and land on the item, not trap outside. Current focus trap implementation resets to group header which is weird.
DesignBot: a11y-check: potential issue detected — focus order when revealing a collapsed group should be sequential. Failure mode: focus jumps to start of nav. See rule: 'reveal-target-focus' should be applied.
Rajiv Kaur: From implementation POV we can keep URL canonical (full path) and then on mount run: openParents(path) + focusOn(pathElement). Simple patch.
Lina Gomez: Product ask — can we avoid "open on hover" to reduce accidental reveals? Also need copy tweak: breadcrumb item for groups should show short name not workspace id. E.g., 'prod-expts' -> 'Experiments'.
Mia Chen: UX nit — when group is collapsed and user tabs in, we shouldn't trap them in the nav; tab into first focusable CTA then escape back. Maybe add a skip link for nav that focuses first main content region.
Samir Patel: Implementation note: adding skip link is trivial. Focus trap behavior: currently we use tabindex -1 on main; need to ensure we don't intercept normal tab flow. I can prototype in a PR.
Noah Rivera: Also consider URL fragment semantics: if we support fragment-scoped anchors (#runs/1234) we might need to normalize when dispatching to openParents.
Lina Gomez: UX priority: landing accuracy > collapse preservation. If linking to a child should always expand parent and animate to it. Low friction for users. :thumbsup:
Mia Chen: Action items: Samir to prototype focus behavior and skip link (due EOW), Rajiv to add openParents+focusOn hook, Noah to write small test plan for keyboard flows, Lina to update copy list for breadcrumb names. I'll create a tiny Figma flow for animation preference.
Samir Patel: ack — will start branch and post short demo.
DesignBot: deploy-bot: new demo posted at https://figma.com/file/abcd1234/nav-demo :eyes:
Mia Chen: thanks — leaving this thread for now. If anyone wants to pair on the keyboard flows ping me.
